behavior: calls Func_0808a8d0(effect_id) once to obtain the alternate resource-group key
walks the 8-byte entries at 0x0809ddd8 until the signed id field is -1
uses entry bit 15 to choose whether the id must match effect_id or the derived resource group
treats the signed 15-bit condition value -1 as a wildcard and otherwise requires it to equal the second argument
returns the first matching entry's pointer, or null when the terminator is reached
